# page main entity

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:pagePrincipalSubject`](gmeow-pagePrincipalSubject.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/pagePrincipalSubject>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/documents`](../../slices/documents.md)

The principal subject a web page is primarily about — the one entity it represents (a person's profile page, an organization's about page). A functional specialisation of [`gmeow:isAbout`](gmeow-isAbout.md) (a page has at most one principal subject, though it may mention many). When the principal subject is an [`Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) the page is inferred a [`gmeow:ProfilePage`](../classes/gmeow-ProfilePage.md).

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:WebPage`](../classes/gmeow-WebPage.md) -> [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md); functional
